name: drips
description: Drips: visual effects over Claude (confetti, fireworks, hearts, a matrix rain), in its window or over the whole screen; save your own recipes and let Claude play them

display.title: Where effects play
display.description: claude-window plays them over Claude's window, in a page in its Browser pane; fullscreen plays them over the whole screen under the pointer (macOS, needs Swift from the Xcode Command Line Tools).

confetti_after_long_turn.title: Confetti after a long turn
confetti_after_long_turn.description: Plays confetti when Claude finishes a turn that ran longer than two minutes.

matrix_while_tools.title: Matrix while tools run
matrix_while_tools.description: Plays a faint matrix rain while Claude's tools run.
